title: Dataobject aggregates Dataobject
description: The containing data structure groups references to another data structure whose instances have their own identity and lifecycle, such as an Order holding the Customer it belongs to or a Cart listing Product records that persist after the cart is discarded.
x-dr-evidence: The containing class declares a field, collection or ID reference typed to the other data object, and that object is constructed, persisted or looked up elsewhere and passed in rather than created by the container.
